Dear CXG Team,

I am writing to apply for the Freelance Luxury Brand Evaluator position. As a customer of premium and luxury brands, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to enhancing the customer experience for prestigious brands. My background in digital marketing and customer experience, combined with my keen observational skills, makes me a suitable candidate for this role.

I am punctual, organized, and detail-oriented, with a passion for understanding what makes exceptional customer service. I have experience evaluating websites and user experiences, and I am comfortable providing objective feedback. I am not currently employed by any retail brand, ensuring the integrity of evaluations.

I am particularly drawn to CXG's mission and the flexibility of mission-based work. I am eager to apply my skills to help shape luxury brand strategies. I have registered on live.cxg.com and am ready to complete the certification process.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your network.

Best regards,

Baver Ok
